reviews.text: Very good, attentive to every detail of the cut with so much passion and I would also say love!!!! Thank you!!!!!! Good continuation!
Very good.

I'm happy to have discovered Dog's Paradise 2.0 because I was met with professionalism, kindness, and a welcoming smile.
Thank you, Nino, for making me and my dog ​​feel at ease from the moment we walked in and for the gentle, thorough wash! We'll be back!

Super professional, but above all kind to animals.
Milo is in love with Giuseppe and for the first time in four years is happy to join the grooming salon.
Even strangers stop me to compliment my look.
They are artists who love their work. And the furry friends sense it immediately.
Thank you, thank you, thank you so much.
Superrrrrrrrr
Excellent and very helpful in accommodating the client's needs in terms of days and times. I highly recommend them!
very good!
Good

Maximum professionalism
All the guys are simply fantastic
Our wonderful dachshund
Thank you so much

Grazie mille! This is a great spot to bring your dog. My dog is small and short haired and just needs a basic bath and toenail trim. They were done so fast, in under an hour and he came back smelling and looking great!

I used their services for the first time recently.

The staff were very kind, friendly, and excellent.

My dog ​​was groomed so beautifully and looked absolutely adorable; I'm so glad I chose this salon. I plan to use their services again in the future.

I highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for a grooming salon in Milan.

Aki, a wary dog, orphaned a week ago, spent one of the most special afternoons in recent years. He was welcomed, his character studied, and given a thorough and loving wash. Nino reassured and cuddled him throughout the procedure as if he were his own dog.
For me, it was a caress and a spectacle to peek at the shearing of other beautiful dogs.
Incredible professionalism and heart.
Congratulations, you couldn't do better.
Lovely guys! Highly recommended. Paco, our flat, was groomed to perfection!

I always take my cocker spaniel, Emilio, to Dog's Paradise 2.0 and couldn't be more satisfied. They are extremely professional, competent, and, above all, they treat each dog with truly special affection and kindness. Emilio is always at ease when he goes to them and comes home beautiful and well-groomed. It's rare to find people who combine passion, love for animals, and great professionalism so well. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy groomer!

Today was my little Didou's first grooming experience, she's just 4 months old, and I couldn't be more satisfied!
Giuseppe was truly excellent; he did an impeccable job with great patience, precision, and a lot of kindness. He took all the time necessary, respecting the little one's schedule and needs, making her feel comfortable during bathing, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and grooming. It's clear he loves his job and puts the animals' well-being first. I'm really happy with the result and will definitely be back.
Furthermore, the prices are very fair considering the excellent quality of the service and the great professionalism. Highly recommended!

I wanted to extend my sincerest compliments to this wonderful grooming salon! A special thanks goes to Giuseppe (the owner), the lady, and Nino: an exceptional team of incredibly cheerful, welcoming, and deeply animal-loving people.
The environment is impeccable and super clean, which immediately instills a sense of trust. What made me happiest, however, was seeing my puppy completely at ease, pampered, and relaxed from start to finish.
I'm truly satisfied with all the work done: the cut and grooming are perfect. We'll definitely be back! Five well-deserved stars. 🐾
I took my cat for a first experience with them. I found Nino to be professional, friendly, and courteous! Kudos to the entire staff! Highly recommended!
Excellent experience, professional and kind
We brought our cat. It was her first time, but she wasn't stressed at all because they were so attentive and gentle! I'm really very satisfied!
I brought Gin, who was pampered and treated wonderfully, leaving smelling good and very meticulously groomed. These guys know their stuff, and I'm sure we'll be back!
Professional, knowledgeable, helpful, and always smiling. The perfect place to groom my toy poodle, Vicky!

Today I took my cat to get his nails trimmed and his fur trimmed.
Nino took care of him, and despite hissing at him, he managed to complete the task with great calm.
A peaceful and friendly environment, thank you!
Grazieeeeeeeee !!! Such an amazing job and feel like got a whole new dog 🐶 …
I'm very happy with Dog's Paradise. Cosmo is happy to go and doesn't seem nervous or scared, which is something that happens to many dogs. The staff is very helpful and compassionate.

Very good and very kind.
I highly recommend them.

Very fair prices and the guys are really good and fun, I took both the dog to get his hair cut and also the cat to get his nails cut (I thank them especially for the cat because he doesn't let himself get his nails cut that easily 😅) …

Perfect, best service I've ever had.
Highly recommend.

Excellent service! 🐶
The staff was very kind and professional, and Robby left feeling beautiful and calm. 💛
You can see how much they love animals. Highly recommended!

Excellent, professional, and very patient with my super naughty Cico, who always comes out looking beautiful and smelling great! You can tell they're passionate about their work.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a trustworthy groomer, the best in Milan!

Yesterday I took my dog ​​Trilly to the grooming salon for the first time in 7 months, and the results were wonderful! She was so beautiful I almost didn't recognize her 😍
I found the staff to be very kind, friendly, and professional, and they treated my dog ​​with such care and kindness.
I'm truly happy with the service I received and will definitely be back. Highly recommended!
A wonderful, patient and professional team. I found them to be very helpful, attentive to detail, and provide a competent and courteous service. Highly recommended!
Top service, I'm a regular customer ♥️
Everything was perfect! We'll definitely be back!
The guys at Dog's Paradise are angels with infinite patience. My dog ​​Moka is a devil, and they always manage to do a perfect job. Thank you so much.
They all work with such passion and the results are noticeable. Thank you.

I love them; they're very good and competent professionals. They have a lot of patience with my dog.
Thank you so much, guys!
The staff were kind and professional. The grooming was precise and exactly what I wanted. Even Tiffany left satisfied.
Excellent and precise staff, I had a really good experience and even my 4-legged friend left satisfied!

Dog's Paradise is a guarantee. The guys are super smart, loving, prepared, and super kind! It's a pleasure to bring my little Spicky to them, when he comes out of there his fur is super clean, shiny, and soft 🥹🫶🏻 I highly recommend it!!! …
As always, my dog's grooming was exactly how I wanted it and so I am definitely satisfied with the result and the service.
Brought my cat in for a wash and brushing. Excellent and comprehensive service with kind and helpful staff. The guy was very knowledgeable and loving. The cat came out practically perfect.

Thank you for making my cat even more beautiful!
You're amazing! Great professionalism and a big heart!
Thank you again!
Thanks Cinzia :)

They're very kind and patient with the furry ones.
Very attentive. I'll definitely be back.
I took Lupa here for the first time last week and had a great time. They're professional and animal lovers. I'll always take her here from now on!

Kindness, professionalism, love, and respect for animals.
The guys and the lady who helps them are very good, meticulous, and can even resolve difficult situations like my dog's yesterday. His fur was tangled and full of knots.
With patience and dedication, they managed to sort it out (in several steps and with various techniques and tools), wash him (with clay shampoo, another shampoo, and a mask), and clip him.
I was delighted and very satisfied. He looked like a different dog. I highly recommend it. Thank you!
Excellent service and friendliness, now regular customers!

We brought Camilla, our super-scary Golden Retriever...they were AMAZING. Camilla wasn't stressed at all, on the contrary, and she came out looking amazing. We'll be back soon. The guys are truly professional and know how to connect with dogs. I highly recommend them to everyone!

Truly excellent.
Very attentive to the well-being of the pet (in our case, a dog) and also to the owner's requests.

Very good.
Real attention to pet care (in our case, a dog) and oriented to customer satisfaction.
Our dog has long hair and was covered in knots. They did a wonderful job, respecting our desire to maintain a natural look. It wasn't easy. They were professional and very kind. We recommend them!
We brought our Siberian cat for a grooming session and found the staff to be friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful! Highly recommended.

I brought my poodle Gus, the guys are really kind, professional, Gus is calm and relaxed with them, they patiently listened to my many requests, satisfying them completely!!! Thank you!! You are really good!
Well done! I absolutely recommend it 😍 …

Today I took Jack, my black miniature schnauzer, for a wash and clipper for the first time. I was very satisfied. The staff are very kind and knowledgeable, attentive to the dog's needs, and patient. The price is average, and it's priceless for us owners to be able to stay a while and try to "encourage" our furry friends!
I'll be back soon!
I came this morning for the first time for my Akita Inu, really excellent service, very short times and very polite staff, low price and truly amazing result, I will definitely go back ☺️

I can't say enough good things about them. Wonderful guys, incredibly sweet and truly professional.
My puppy wouldn't let anyone touch him, even though I tried several places, but with them he immediately felt at ease.
With patience, gentleness, and a lot of love, they managed to groom him perfectly.
You can see they work with heart, great professionalism, and a great passion for animals.
I recommend this place, without a doubt! 🐾💙

I loved it! I live in Switzerland and brought my little bearded girl here, and they made her look absolutely beautiful. Thank you so much, you are very kind. I will always come back and I highly recommend it.
A guarantee... Our Schnauzer trusts these guys fearlessly and naturally from the first stripping. Super professional, precise, and loving. Never again without them, and Smoky thanks him.

Our little Lucio is truly a white cloud when he comes out, without a single knot.
Professionals in the field!
Highly recommended!
Thank you, thank you!

The team is super professional and available to handle the needs of our furry "babies"!
Renoir is a very docile but large dog and requires a lot of time to groom.
Giuseppe and Nino are wonderful people and gave Renoir all the care and attention he needed,
using excellent products.
Thank you so much for all the love you put into your profession, giving us back clean and fragrant "babies."
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED for anyone who still doesn't know where to take their furry friend to be groomed.

This is the real spa for my poodles Carla and Fulmine.
The guys and girls who work here are spectacular, incredibly talented, and professional.
They're precise, honest, and give an excellent, beautiful cut!
Highly recommended, highly recommended.

The owners are very kind, especially with my puppy who is active, hairy, and vocal. He is not easy and Dog's Paradise was patient, kind, and did an EXCELLENT job grooming him. They also understood how to groom a Lagotto. Not everyone knows how to do this. (He is not a poodle.) Thank you very much!!

Today I took Lucky for his first grooming at Dog's Paradise 2.0 and I'm so thrilled with the result!

The staff was friendly, professional, and very attentive: they made Lucky feel at ease and cared for him with genuine love. Lucky came out beautiful, smelling great, and all groomed.

Thank you so much to all the staff: super kind and talented! You can tell they love what they do and truly care about their furry friends.

Thank you so much, guys, see you soon! 🐶✨

Fantastic and super expert guys.
My Piero came out smelling great and clean. We're regular customers now!

Well, what can I say... WONDERFUL AND SUPER PROFESSIONAL.
I brought my dog ​​Kara, and she came out super clean and smelling great.
The whole team is so sweet, helpful, and patient. I was able to see how they work and nothing... pure joy for the heart.
I will definitely go back because in my opinion, they are the best.
Thank you. 🫶🏻

Giuseppe and Nino are simply fantastic! My dogs have never looked so beautiful as when they leave their grooming salon. They are true professionals: competent, honest, and always kind. I highly recommend their service to anyone who wants to entrust their pets to expert and loving hands.
Thank you so much from me, Polly, and Pepa! 🐾💛
Very professional and friendly staff. They did a great job cleaning Amber. We'll definitely be back!

A truly positive experience! Teo was pampered and cared for perfectly; you can tell they truly love animals. Thank you so much, we'll definitely be back❤️
Highly recommended!

Professional but also very attentive to our four-legged friends, whom they certainly treat with great care and attention, furthermore they use high-quality products, which is evident in the results obtained.
Antonino did an excellent job with Remo, a wire-haired dachshund mix. After years of abuse and kennels, he needed someone to care for him and his fur. Thank you for your patience and professionalism.
Very kind guys and they did a great job! I'll definitely be back ♥️
Great guys, my little Joseph comes out of your grooming salon more beautiful than ever ❤️
Professionals! Efficient and very good at treating all breeds, I recommend them 🥰 …

I finally found the right place to groom my poodle.
The staff was incredibly kind and attentive.
Since I've been bringing my cats to this groomer they've always been clean and tidy and above all without knots. I highly recommend it.

I took my Maltipoo for his first full grooming and they made him beautiful! Super professional, attentive to detail, and above all, they made my puppy feel at ease, as he usually doesn't like to be touched on his face and doesn't like to sit still.
Thank you! 🤎 …

Highly recommended! Today I took my Kiki, a black Maremma Sheepdog mix, to the salon, and I'm thrilled with the result.
These are competent, super kind, and affectionate professionals, attentive to the dog's needs.
Thank you so much ❤️ for your care and professionalism...we'll definitely be back soon 🐶💕
Great Nino, super good. He even waited for me past closing time. Joy, super clean and happy.
The guys are very good at their job and make the dogs feel at ease.

Fantastic experience with my long-haired Chihuahua. The grooming was expertly done with the utmost attention to detail, a perfect cut, and high-quality, fragrant products. Thank you! I recommend it to everyone because it's truly worth it.
Very kind and professional, I absolutely recommend them!!
A stuffed animal 😍😍😍 exactly as I asked for. Very good and very kind 🥰 …

I took my three dogs to this groomer today for the first time and I had a GREAT time! The two guys were very kind and had a lot of patience with all three of them, even though they were a little nervous. Highly recommended, even for those with dogs who don't like being handled much. And most importantly, they left looking LIKE NEW, shiny, and smelling great.
We'll definitely be back! 🥹
We brought our golden retriever puppy and had a great time. Super professional and kind, thank you so much!!
Great and kind guys. I absolutely recommend them!

I took Ruby, my almost 7-month-old poodle, to Dog's Paradise 2.0. I'm so happy, she's beautiful and happy, and the staff are professional and kind. I really liked the shop; it's all open, clean, and welcoming. Dog's Paradise will become our "beauty salon"! Thanks guys!! 🤩 …

Very good and very kind with the furry ones, patient with their owners. Competent and prepared, I gladly bring my dog, who today after being groomed is a fragrant and soft cloud. Guys, keep it up 🐶😘 …

I took my Shiba Inu to Dog's Paradise 2.0 and was thrilled!
He's not an easy dog ​​to care for: he has extremely sensitive skin, several allergies, and is prone to redness. Yet he left spotless, smelling great, and most importantly, sore thanks to the ozone bath.

The team is attentive, competent, and incredibly gentle, with a care that goes beyond simple aesthetics. You can sense passion, expertise, and love for animals in every gesture.

Excellent grooming.
The owners are fantastic, fantastic people and exceptionally good at their job. I recommend them to everyone in Milan for the way they treat dogs and cats. No one else around is so good!

A great experience for my poodle Vaniglia. Congratulations to the entire team
and especially to Giuseppe, who is talented, patient, and very professional. 🔝 …

I have a Lagotto Romagnolo known for being very reactive during grooming and a Bolognese who isn't fond of human contact, but yesterday these two gorgeous guys performed a true miracle! Honestly, they'd been neglected a lot in the past few months and were full of knots and in really bad shape. My Rocco didn't cause any problems, and my baby girl let me groom her even more than she was before. They turned out beautifully! I thank Nino and Giuseppe for their professionalism, kindness, and sweetness. See you soon.
If you're looking for a place to take your dog, this is the right place! I assure you.
Be careful, no one pays me to review, no one asked me to, and I didn't know them before yesterday.
Exceptional guys and impeccable service, highly recommended

Excellent experience at Dog's Paradise: professional and excellent with our George. Both times we had grooming sessions, we had a great time and were very satisfied. George is a true prince thanks to them!!
Highly recommended, and we will definitely continue to take him there!!!
I brought my Chihuahua Adele to these guys...I'm thrilled with the professionalism and attention to detail they showed for my little girl...I absolutely recommend them...
They're great! When Leopoldo comes home from the grooming, he sheds much less hair.
Everything was perfect! I took my Scottish Fold cat to be washed and it was great. Thanks to the team!

Hi everyone, I've been taking my miniature schnauzer to Dog's Paradise 2.0 grooming for many months now, and I can only say that they are excellent, super professional, and very, very good with my little hyena. Super fantastic, try it and believe it 😜👏👏 …

This is the second time we've taken our cocker spaniel Charlie to the groomer, but my mom and I decided right from the first that Giuseppe and his partner would officially be our dog's groomers, both because they're incredibly empathetic with him, even though he's a real coward, and because Giuseppe is incredibly skilled at grooming, which isn't easy for a cocker spaniel. I recommend everyone give it a try because it's truly worth it.
First time and already a wonderful surprise! My dog ​​felt at ease right away, and left feeling clean, smelling good, and happy. The atmosphere was super calm and welcoming, I'll definitely be back!

We are extremely satisfied with the grooming service for our dog, Joy!
The Dog's Paradise 2.0 team was exceptional: professional, kind, and very attentive to the animal's well-being.
Joy was pampered with love and care, and left happy and beautiful!
Thank you so much—we will definitely be back and recommend this place to everyone!

The environment is clean. The staff is professional and efficient. They are good at interacting with the animal (dog or cat). The result is excellent. Jonny, my dog, is as satisfied as his owner. Keep up the good work!

I brought my golden retriever and couldn't be happier. They were extremely kind and knowledgeable, immediately putting my dog, who's always a little scared, at ease. They took care of her with care and patience! Her coat is perfect, soft and shiny. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality service for their dog!
Polite, professional, and gentle. Gaspare is perfect! Thanks guys.

I went to them with my dog, who's bath-phobic, but their professionalism made everything easier. Giuseppe and Nino are incredibly talented and attentive to the well-being of the dog/cat. Thank you so much, from now on they'll be my trusted groomer!

Excellent choice! We're truly delighted with Giuseppe's approach, his skills, and the beautiful results of bathing and stripping our wirehaired dachshund. We'll definitely be back and highly recommend him!
Lovely place and owners !! They cut my German Spitz hair today,  and left him looking amazing. Thank you!!
Thank you for taking such good care of Zoe. Well done to you and the products you use are excellent.

I was very hesitant before entrusting myself to them, especially because my dog ​​is very fearful. I must say that the staff were truly kind and affectionate, showing great care for him. My puppy came home soft, smelling good, and happy. Thank you!

Impeccable service and top-notch professionalism!!! Thank you Nino,
You were brilliant! I highly recommend you guys try them!!! They're truly excellent. SUN thanks you!

Giuseppe is a guarantee of professionalism and passion. Our long-haired Jack Russell suffers from atopic dermatitis and has no undercoat. Therefore, he can't be stripped. He only needed a bath and a trim, but given the terrible conditions we'd reached (poor Sonic), Giuseppe recommended we clip him with scissors. The result: a new dog (🤣), with a shiny, soft coat after just a few days, a little lord. If you have to entrust your furry friend to someone, trust Giuseppe's golden hands.

Highly recommended. Giuseppe is very sensitive and calm with the dogs, who felt at ease. We brought all three of them, all dressed up after the Christmas holidays!, and they all smelled lovely. Stripping our dachshund, Sandrino, was perfect, and that's no small feat; not everyone in Milan knows how to do it!
Shop just opened but extremely professional. Ofelia has never been so beautiful and fragrant. We will definitely be back!
